name: Lotex SEO for WooCommerce
author: lotexdev

sections.description:
Lotex SEO for WooCommerce helps WooCommerce store owners review important SEO, technical, and store-related issues from inside the WordPress dashboard.

All features included in this plugin are free and fully functional. The plugin includes practical SEO checks for posts, pages, products, important pages, structured data, internal links, redirects, 404 errors, WooCommerce product SEO, and optional PageSpeed performance reports.

Main Features

  • Site Audit dashboard for important SEO and technical checks.
  • On-Page SEO checks for important pages.
  • WooCommerce SEO checks for products, categories, and store pages.
  • Product SEO analyzer inside the WooCommerce product editor.
  • Schema and Rich Results checks based on page data available in WordPress.
  • Internal link suggestions and internal link map.
  • Redirects and 404 monitoring.
  • Optional performance report using Google PageSpeed Insights API.
  • Security and trust checks for common WordPress configuration issues.
  • SEO editor metabox for posts, pages, and products.

WooCommerce SEO

Lotex SEO for WooCommerce can review product SEO issues such as missing or weak product titles, descriptions, product images, alt text, product categories, and other store-related SEO signals.

The WooCommerce checks run inside your WordPress site and do not send product data to an external service.

PageSpeed Insights Report

The performance report uses Google PageSpeed Insights API only when the site administrator clicks the performance scan button.

The scan is not started automatically when the page is opened.

The plugin sends the requested page URL to Google PageSpeed Insights API in order to generate the performance report. Results may be cached inside WordPress to reduce repeated requests.

External Services

This plugin uses the following external service:

Google PageSpeed Insights API

Used for: optional performance and speed reports when the administrator manually starts a PageSpeed scan.

Data sent: the URL of the page/site being tested.

Service provider: Google LLC

Google PageSpeed Insights API documentation:
https://developers.google.com/speed/docs/insights/v5/get-started

Google Privacy Policy:
https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google Terms of Service:
https://policies.google.com/terms

The PageSpeed scan is optional and is only triggered from the plugin page by an administrator action.

Lotex SEO Pro

Lotex SEO Pro is an optional separate product for advanced reports that may use external processing and specialized data providers, such as keyword tracking, backlinks, competitor analysis, competitor ads, product activity reports, and AI-assisted SEO workflows.

Those advanced services are not required to use this plugin. All features included in this plugin work as described in the feature list above.

Pro information page:
https://seo.lotex-dev.com/pricing.php
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/lotex-ascs/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  4. Open the “Lotex SEO” menu in your WordPress dashboard.
  5. Start with the Site Audit, WooCommerce SEO Check, On-Page SEO Check, or PageSpeed report.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. This plugin is built for WooCommerce stores and declares WooCommerce as a required plugin.

Does the plugin send my product data to external services?

No. The WooCommerce SEO checks run inside your WordPress site. Product data is not sent to Google PageSpeed Insights.

Does the plugin connect to Google?

Only the optional PageSpeed performance report connects to Google PageSpeed Insights API. This happens when an administrator manually clicks the scan button. The URL being tested is sent to Google so the report can be generated.

Does PageSpeed run automatically?

No. The PageSpeed scan does not run automatically when the page is opened. It only runs when the administrator clicks the scan button.

Can I use the plugin without PageSpeed?

Yes. SEO checks, WooCommerce checks, Schema checks, internal links, redirects, and 404 monitoring run locally inside WordPress. PageSpeed is only needed for the optional performance report.

What happens if the PageSpeed API fails?

The plugin shows a simple message asking the user to try again later. Existing SEO checks remain available.

Are all included features free?

Yes. All functionality included in this plugin is free and fully functional.

Where can I get support?

You can contact support from:
https://seo.lotex-dev.com/contact.php

Where can I read the privacy policy?

Privacy Policy:
https://seo.lotex-dev.com/privacy-policy.php

Terms of Service:
https://seo.lotex-dev.com/terms.php
